cases.name: Maria Fernanda Elizabeth Pew
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Maria Fernanda Elizabeth Maria Pew left this world April 30, 2020. Her funny observations, sparkling eyes and big smile, gentleness and unwavering love live forever. Maria was a bit magical, a bit ethereal. In her world, she saw spirits and angels. Maria was always herself, an observer, real in each moment, quietly true to her feelings. At 28, Maria said she was so proud she was a work in progress! There is no bottom to missing her. Maria is best friend and daughter to Bill Pew and Lissa Weimelt. At Bill's side, Maria hunted, fished, rode horses like the wind, shot trap, and drove cars, snowmobiles and four wheelers-- fast. She was a confident and poised girl, rocking tight leggings, 4-inch heels with red Latina dresses, and black biker gear. Maria was a gymnast, dancer and cheerleading flyer, loving to perform and win. She was intrigue, combining impish, sweet, sensual and charming. She was crazy in love with her dogs, especially Rocky, her Mr. Wigglebutt. Maria loved the ocean and lakes, the magic of sunset, and her footprints in the sand. She really loved her parents, always calling, staying close and chowing down her favorite meal, Pheasant a la Pew. She got her BA cum laude by working hard. Maria loved jobs in sales and creative marketing. Fairness was important to her, and she chose to see good and possibility in others."

https://www.startribune.com/obituaries/detail/0000357608/
cases.narrative: Her body was stuffed in a crawlspace in her house. She died from asphyxiation / suffocation from duct tape and a plastic bag that had been placed over her mouth and nose.
